derivation.all_red_rule: SUMO state contains only red and CityFlow permits no movement
derivation.clearance_rule: any SUMO state containing yellow is clearance_yellow even when its CityFlow conversion retains permitted movements
derivation.compound_rule: SUMO state has green and no yellow and serves movement, but declared duration is shorter than min-green; preserve only inside transitions
derivation.selectable_rule: SUMO state has green and no yellow, CityFlow phase serves movement, and declared duration is min-green compatible
derivation.transition_rule: preserve every non-selectable phase after a selectable source in cyclic plan order until the next selectable phase; use that source-exit sequence for every directed switch

id_mapping_rule: exact CityFlow intersection id, otherwise GS_ prefix

limitations.source_signal_states: tracked SUMO tlLogic state strings, bound by source_sumo_network hash
limitations.synthetic_normalization: intersection 5896811072 splits one source action into two policy actions exactly as declared by the provenance repair

role_vocabulary.all_red: source state is all red; transition-only lost time
role_vocabulary.clearance_yellow: source state contains yellow; transition-only lost time
role_vocabulary.compound_service: movement-serving source stage shorter than min_green; transition-only
role_vocabulary.selectable_green: movement-serving policy action compatible with min_green
